import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv("opsd_de_load.csv", parse_dates=["utc_timestamp"])
df = df.rename(columns={"DE_load_actual_entsoe_transparency":"load"})
print("rows:", len(df))
print("range:", df.utc_timestamp.min(), "->", df.utc_timestamp.max())
print("NaNs in load:", df.load.isna().sum())
# check hourly continuity
full = pd.date_range(df.utc_timestamp.min(), df.utc_timestamp.max(), freq="h", tz="UTC")
print("expected hourly rows:", len(full), "missing timestamps:", len(full)-len(df))
print(df.load.describe())
# target week
mask = (df.utc_timestamp>=pd.Timestamp("2020-01-01",tz="UTC")) & (df.utc_timestamp<pd.Timestamp("2020-01-08",tz="UTC"))
print("target week rows:", mask.sum(), "NaNs:", df.load[mask].isna().sum())

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.dates as mdates

out = pd.read_pickle("_out.pkl")
# independent re-verification of headline metric straight from the saved CSV
csv = pd.read_csv("forecast_jan2020_week1.csv")
mape = (np.abs(csv.forecast_MW - csv.actual_MW)/csv.actual_MW).mean()*100
mae  = np.abs(csv.forecast_MW - csv.actual_MW).mean()
print(f"[recheck from CSV] n={len(csv)}  MAPE={mape:.2f}%  MAE={mae:.0f} MW  "
      f"peak_actual={csv.actual_MW.max():.0f}  min_actual={csv.actual_MW.min():.0f}")

t = pd.to_datetime(out["local_time"])
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(13, 7.5), sharex=True,
                               gridspec_kw={"height_ratios":[3,1]})
ax1.plot(t, out.actual_MW/1000, color="#1b1b1b", lw=1.8, label="Actual")
ax1.plot(t, out.forecast_MW/1000, color="#e4572e", lw=1.6, ls="--", label="Forecast (GBM)")
ax1.set_ylabel("Load (GW)")
ax1.set_title("German electricity load — forecast vs actual, 1–7 Jan 2020 (hourly, local time)")
ax1.legend(loc="upper left", frameon=False)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.25)
# shade New Year's Day
ax1.axvspan(pd.Timestamp("2020-01-01 00:00"), pd.Timestamp("2020-01-02 00:00"),
            color="#4a90d9", alpha=0.10)
ax1.annotate("New Year's Day\n(public holiday)", xy=(pd.Timestamp("2020-01-01 12:00"), 45),
             ha="center", fontsize=8, color="#33648f")

err = out.forecast_MW - out.actual_MW
ax2.bar(t, err/1000, width=0.03, color=np.where(err>=0,"#e4572e","#4a90d9"))
ax2.axhline(0, color="k", lw=0.8)
ax2.set_ylabel("Error (GW)")
ax2.grid(alpha=0.25)
ax2.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter("%a %d"))
ax2.xaxis.set_major_locator(mdates.DayLocator())
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig("forecast_jan2020_week1.png", dpi=130)
print("wrote forecast_jan2020_week1.png")
PY
